description: HSE approval date set to the version 2 date (2015-05-30): the indication is present in version 2 of the treatment regimen (https://web.archive.org/web/20151021190940/http://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/Gastrointestinal/NCCP_Panitumumab_Monotherapy_Protocol.pdf) and the version note says, "new indications added". I cannot find a version 1 version of this treatment regimen. So, given that it is indication c and the version 2 goes up to c, I am interpreting that "new indications" refers to 00225c and maybe 00225b.
